classification: exact-moment comparator audit; not sampled or formal evidence

analysis.primary_comparison: fully charged T-068A dynamic safe oracle divided by the cellwise best recipient-specific static vector
analysis.scalar_consistency: the common-alpha subset must reproduce every T-068A strong-fixed risk

mandatory_gates.Q1: all 648 cells and 839808 evaluated static-vector risks are finite
mandatory_gates.Q2: the common-alpha subset reproduces every T-068A strong-fixed risk within 1e-10 relative tolerance
mandatory_gates.Q3: the recipient-specific vector oracle is no worse than the common-alpha oracle in every cell
mandatory_gates.Q4: the fully charged dynamic safe oracle improves aggregate geometric risk over the recipient-specific static oracle by at least 3%
mandatory_gates.Q5: the fully charged dynamic safe oracle strictly improves at least 40% of cells
mandatory_gates.Q6: dynamic safe mixing has nonnegative aggregate improvement in at least three of four heterogeneity groups
mandatory_gates.Q7: dynamic safe mixing has nonnegative aggregate improvement in every registered delay group
mandatory_gates.Q8: at least eight distinct recipient-specific static vectors are selected
mandatory_gates.Q9: the frozen T-068A source hash and 648-cell identity are exact
